title: Oven-Roasted Salmon Sandwiches
description: Salmon roasted with ghee under foil, served on toasted whole wheat bread with mayo, pesto, avocado, and bread-and-butter pickles.

ingredients.name: Trader Joe's sweet and spicy jalapeño slices (optional)

instructions.text: Heat the oven to 425°F. Place {0} salmon skin side down on a sheet of foil. Dot with {1} ghee and season with {2} salt and {3} pepper. Fold the foil into a sealed packet or crimp the edges into a boat.
Roast 10 minutes. The salmon is done when it flakes easily with a fork and is opaque through the thickest part. Let it rest in the foil 2 minutes, then break into large chunks.
Toast {4} bread slices to your liking.
Spread {5} mayo on one slice and {6} pesto on the other. Layer half the salmon, half of {7} avocado, and {8} pickles on each sandwich. Add {9} jalapeño slices if using. Close and serve immediately.

notes:
Foil boat vs. sealed packet: a boat keeps the salmon moist and produces a little steam; a sealed packet steams more aggressively. Either works at 425°F for 10 minutes for a ~4.5 oz portion.

Avocado: half a ripe avocado per sandwich. If the avocado is very ripe, a light mash on the bread also works.

Pairs well with grilled asparagus or any oven-roasted vegetables.
